CLUB INFO

Welcome to Our Club

About this location

We strive to create a workout environment where everyone feels accepted and respected. That’s why at Planet Fitness Milwaukie (Hwy 224 & SE Oak St), OR, we make sure our club is clean and welcoming, our team members are friendly, and our certified trainers are ready to help. Whether you’re a first-time gym user or a fitness veteran, you’ll always have a home in our Judgement Free Zone®. Download our free PF mobile app and get access to hundreds of workout videos, a personal fitness tracker, partner rewards and discounts and more.

Club Hours

  • Mon: 12:00 AM - 12:00 AM
  • Tue: 12:00 AM - 12:00 AM
  • Wed: 12:00 AM - 12:00 AM
  • Thu: 12:00 AM - 12:00 AM
  • Fri: 12:00 AM - 10:00 PM

Sat & Sun: 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM

WORK OUT WITH US

Equipment and Support

Step up your workout with our free fitness trainers

Our certified fitness trainers will show you around the gym and provide instruction on our huge selection of cardio and strength machines. Our gym trainers also facilitate a wide variety of small group training sessions and are available to design an exercise program to help you meet your goals and get the most out of your workouts.

Tons of equipment

Our assortment of strength equipment features user-friendly machines to target each of your muscle groups.
  • Selectorized (pin-loaded) equipment
  • Cable Towers
  • Plate Loaded Options (Hack Squat, Leg Press, Calf Raise, Supine Bench Press, etc.)
  • Free Weights (Dumbbells & Barbells)
  • Abs and stretching
  • Smith machines
  • 30 Minute circuit
Our state-of-the-art cardio equipment offers something for everyone, to get the heart pumping and work up a sweat, all at your own pace.
  • Treadmill
  • Elliptical
  • Rower
  • Upright Bike
  • Stepmill
  • Recumbent Stepper
  • Recumbent Bike
  • Arcs
  • Upper Body Ergometer
Add variety to your workout routine and build overall strength by incorporating exercises that mimic everyday activities and work multiple muscle groups simultaneously.
  • Functional Stations (Battle Ropes, Cable Tower, Kettlebells, Strength Bands, Medicine Balls, etc.)

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Cookie/Tracking Technologies

Under certain state privacy laws, you have the right to opt-out of the sale of your personal information to third parties. These cookies and similar technologies collect information for analytics and to personalize your experience with targeted ads. You may exercise your right to opt out of the sale of personal information by using this toggle switch. If you opt out, we will disable all non-essential cookies and will not be able to offer you personalized ads and will not hand over your personal information to any third parties.

If you have enabled privacy controls on your browser (such as a plugin), we have to take that as a valid request to opt-out. Therefore, we would not be able to track your activity through the web. This may affect our ability to personalize ads according to your preferences.

  • Performance Cookies
    label

    These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies or similar technologies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

  • Targeting Cookies
    label

    These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertisements on other sites. If you do not allow these cookies and similar technologies, you may experience less relevant advertising.
